A4-OPEN.text: We know how to give the gates back to their stations.
At the moment? Three very convincing blanks.
Then start with people. The machinery can wait to be impressed.
And nobody changes anything until every station answers.
Put that at the top. I'll be at the Compass when you're ready to ask.

A4-MARA-CONSENT.text: Will you attend the quay station? I need someone who knows it and will say no if a reading is doubtful.
Including when you want the answer to be yes?
I'll open the dry access. We inspect it together. No promises about a machine I haven't seen in years.
That's the promise I was asking for.

A4-ROOK-BRIEF.text: The local lever has a test path. With the drive disengaged, the indicator moves and the gate does not.
So I can prove a station is ready without making it responsible for the harbour yet.
Exactly. I wish my grandfather had written that sentence before the paragraph about his genius.
After you inspect it with me. Give me the actual reading, not a flattering approximation.

A4-MARA-DOOR.text: I locked this after the relief run. I told myself leaving it closed was the same as making it safe.
We can leave it closed if the inspection fails.
Yes. This time that will be a decision we can explain.

A4-VANE-REPLY.text: The trials separated movements because predictable dispatch keeps the route clear. A common account gives me a common schedule. I will defend that policy before the harbour.
The slips list the missing contract as the reason for the hold, not a hazard.
Then print the slips beside my answer. I have no intention of pretending the arrangement is accidental.

A4-PIP-PUBLISH.text: This one can survive somebody reading the second paragraph.
Especially that one. Otherwise it is an advertisement with grievances.

A4-VANE-OFFER.text: A proper vessel. A salary. Your name above the survey office instead of below a correction.
Remain with the company. A chart that can move traffic is a responsibility.
So I choose where I go. You choose who can follow.
You asked for independence. I am offering it.

A4-VANE-REFUSE.text: I want the boat. I want the work. That is why I had to read the last condition twice.
You would rather trust three separate stations?
Three named attendants, one observation revision, and an instruction each of them can question.
We rehearsed. You are welcome to inspect the record.
Then we will both be judged on whether our arrangements work.

A4-BRAM-LINE.text: Repair Quay maintenance. Watch D, revision one. Can you read me back?
Bellweather maintenance. Repair Quay, Watch D, revision one. The line works. That is not yet a report about the gates.
We are keeping those achievements separate.

A4-END-REVIEW.text: Outer, quay, inlet. Same revision. Every answer has a name.
And every name knows it can say hold.
A surprisingly useful addition to command.

A4-VANE-ANNOUNCE.text: Fair Passage announces the centralisation sequence for the next major tide. Existing controls remain in force until the dispatch change is issued.
Then no one jumps ahead of it. Hold the prepared settings.

A4-END.text: Second Opinion ready at Blind Inlet. Departure check when you arrive.
We have a harbour that can answer back. Now I need to reach the place giving the orders.

A4-ACK-OUTER.text: Outer Landing. Watch D, revision one. High, detent B, local test passed. I hold for a verified handover; central control remains in charge.

A4-ACK-QUAY.text: Repair Quay. Watch D, revision one. Low, detent A, local test passed. I'll hold. If the observation changes, this acknowledgement changes with it.

A4-ACK-INLET.text: Service Inlet at Blind Inlet. Watch D, revision one. Low, detent C, test passed. Holding for handover.

A4-EGG-MASCOT.text: The monkey has changed its mind.
The advertising department assures me it has always believed the newest thing.
Its spokesperson has declined to comment.

A4-EGG-CLOCK.text: A visitor from the distant pocket.
The appointment is yesterday, the inspection is tomorrow, and the lint is regrettably available now.
I shall leave chronology to the breakfast department.

A4-EGG-CREDIT.text: Does the self get a day off?
It is mentioned in the larger manual.

A4-ORIN-READY.text: Second Opinion stays ready at Blind Inlet. I will captain the next voyage. We check the departure water when you come aboard.
Then the inlet attendant stays ashore, and the captain stays with the boat.

topics.question: Do you want your old account printed?

lines.text: Print the documents you can support. If my account belongs beside them, ask me about that page. Don't turn my apology into a headline without me.

topics.question: Are you afraid to go back?

lines.text: Yes. Fear is allowed on a watch. Unreported doubt isn't.

topics.question: Will an apology put this right?

lines.text: No. It does let the next piece of work begin without a lie underneath it.

topics.question: The chair still has your name.

lines.text: Then write today's date beside it. The name isn't a current reading either.

topics.question: What if my instruction sounds wrong?

lines.text: I'll ask you to repeat it. Then I'll ask why. You specifically requested an inconvenient attendant.
Was it a bad ship?
No.
Good offers can still ask too much.

topics.question: Will you correct your account for the paper?

lines.text: Yes. I saw the marker and the barrier. I did not see who ordered them. My certainty had travelled farther than I had.

topics.question: Can you attend the inlet station?

lines.text: Not while taking you to the shoal. Choose someone who can remain ashore without acquiring a second body.
With a checked departure window and the route in front of us. Second Opinion has no objection to repetition.
Enough to know where to look. Not enough to know what the water is doing when we leave.
He has excellent volume. We are now working on content.
He repeats the station before the instruction. That is more useful than sounding certain.

topics.question: I turned down the company vessel.

lines.text: Then we'll use mine for this trip. Ownership and having somewhere to go remain separate problems.
I can command the inlet.
Attend it.
A less dramatic verb.
A more specific one. Fine Print, will you keep the readbacks?
If my name remains on the record.

topics.question: Does the last watch count as training?

lines.text: It counts as the last watch. We are resisting the temptation to let nouns qualify themselves.
My proclamation.
And the absence of a barrier. We have arranged both.

topics.question: What if the instruction names the wrong station?

lines.text: I hold position, name mine, and request correction.
Without challenging the message to a duel?
I shall struggle privately.

topics.question: Does the clause forbid all fees?

lines.text: No. Clause Seven is still present even when it is inconvenient to a headline.
I can prepare a review record. The harbour must hear it. Meanwhile, water continues without waiting for jurisdiction.

topics.question: Could you carry the signal yourself?

lines.text: I am your witness, not a substitute for testing the wire.

topics.question: Why didn't your family share these instructions?

lines.text: Somebody mistook being consulted for being indispensable. We inherited a great deal of filing.
No. Provided the drive is disengaged, as that very large label says. The test moves its own indicator.
Because Watch C was a lesson. The water has not agreed to repeat it for your convenience.
Only if we disagree about which station they belong to. A map needs differences.
Yes. With the revision number attached. I am attempting a family tradition in reverse.
Three controls, one shared assumption. You solved the assumption. Please do not now apply the breakfast settings to a sluice.
Enough to investigate. Give each claim its own source.
Enough for these claims. Not for the larger ones you crossed out.

topics.question: Must my commission be in it?

lines.text: You accepted an operational commission. That does not make the measurements false. Leaving it out would make our account incomplete.
Because we asked what she is defending. The documents can sit beside her defence without falling over.
Then they will have something precise to disagree about. I consider that an improvement in circulation.
Paper can make an order visible. You still need to deal with the order.
Yes. The machine's one agreeable habit.
No. I commissioned accuracy and received it.
Then our dispute is about what you require of everyone using it.
Correct. I announce changes before making them.

topics.question: Were you the old relief-run operator?

lines.text: No. If you intend to make an accusation, use a record that contains me.
And permits recorded safety restrictions. I expect your paper to print both sentences.

topics.question: Why keep the command floor locked?

lines.text: Because inspection and issuing instructions are not the same authority.

topics.question: Could I publish working charts under your offer?

lines.text: Through the company. Otherwise I would be buying coordination and funding its contradiction.

topics.question: May I take time to decide?

lines.text: Certainly. The tide's schedule is not a negotiation, but this conversation need not imitate it.

topics.question: I have declined. Will you withdraw the policy?

lines.text: No. You have proposed an alternative. I have not accepted that it is better.
The dry service route is. The command floor is secured. Come to the maintenance landing, not the company's rail.

topics.question: Can you stop the centre now?

lines.text: Not safely on your word that you intend to prepare the stations. I need their actual acknowledgements, and you need to be at the bypass.

topics.question: We have tested the local paths.

lines.text: Tell me which ones. A collective noun is not a test record.
Keep the settings staged and the drives disengaged. The live handover is separate work.

topics.question: Does the emergency signal prove an emergency?

lines.text: It proves someone asserted emergency authority. The useful feature is that everybody receives the assertion.
At maintenance access. I shall bring the instructions. It would be eccentric to stop now.
It says BY BRAM underneath. Read the small line. Apparently this is the chapter for it.
